about: Renders a dial a person turns a thumb around to pick an angle from 0° to 359°. The arrow keys step the angle, PageUp and PageDown step it tenfold, and Home and End set its bounds.

controlled.about: A controlled angle in steps of 5°, and the CSS gradient it writes.
controlled.title: Controlled

field.about: A panel's tilt in a field: the field's label names the thumb, and a tilt outside the allowed band shows the error text on save.
field.title: In a field

palette.about: The palette the range, the thumb's edge and the focus ring read. An invalid dial takes the error palette in place of any of them.
palette.title: Palettes

panel.helper: Panels on this roof tilt from {{lowest}}° to {{highest}}°.
panel.label: Panel tilt

rtl.about: `dir="rtl"` mirrors the dial for a right-to-left page: the angle grows anticlockwise, and ArrowLeft steps it up.
rtl.title: Right to left

size.about: The dial is 6, 8 and 10rem wide, its ring 4, 6 and 8px thick and its thumb a circle of the tag height from `sm` to `lg`. The value reads the heading role at the same size.
size.title: Sizes

states.about: A disabled dial is dimmed and leaves the tab order. A read-only one keeps its tab stop, dashes its thumb's edge and refuses every key. An invalid one takes the error palette.
states.title: States

steps.about: A `step` of 45° with a marker at every step, on a ring without a range. The value text and the thumb's `aria-valuetext` name the compass point in place of the angle.
steps.title: Steps and markers

title: Angle slider

variant.about: The slider's two looks. The outline ring rests on a muted ground with a panel thumb edged in the palette's solid, and the subtle ring takes the palette's muted role under a solid thumb.
variant.title: Looks
